# Hulm Solutions: FBR-Ready Cloud POS Software for Pakistani Businesses

> Hulm Solutions provides Hulm POS, a cloud-based point of sale and business operations platform for Pakistani retailers, restaurants, pharmacies, cafes, salons, bakeries, ecommerce businesses, and multi-branch companies. Hulm POS helps businesses manage billing, inventory, customers, purchases, vendors, reporting, integrations, FBR-ready invoicing, and online selling from one dashboard.

Brand name: Hulm Solutions
Product name: Hulm POS
Primary category: Cloud-based POS software
Primary market: Pakistan
Expansion markets: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, USA
Primary wedge: FBR-ready cloud POS software for Pakistani SMEs
Primary use cases: retail POS, restaurant POS, pharmacy POS, cafe POS, bakery POS, salon POS, inventory management, FBR POS integration, ZATCA-ready POS workflows, ecommerce POS
